meta.detector_fit_population: TRAIN split lots: lot-standardised [z_level, z_change] of valid peer groups
meta.normalisation_population: CALIBRATION split lots (held out from detector fitting)
meta.caveat: Both populations contain planted anomalies at generator rates; tau is a reference exceedance rate on those lots, not a guaranteed false-alarm rate on new lots.
meta.ensemble: weighted mean of calibration percentiles of robust, Isolation Forest and ECOD scores
meta.ensemble_threshold_note: Global ensemble threshold = 98% quantile of the ensemble score over known-healthy parameters of SYNTHETIC validation lots (n=935). Synthetic labels only; must be re-set on approved real reference lots before any real use.
